title: PHILGEPS + UNGM OPPORTUNITY BRIEFING

executive_summary.source_access_notes: PhilGEPS public category pages were checked directly for Information Technology, Consulting Services, Communication Equipment & Parts and Accessories, Services, Office Equipment, and Advertising Agency Services. This run reviewed the first visible public page for each scoped PhilGEPS category plus targeted official-notice rechecks for tracked fits. UNGM public search and notice pages were scanned live from the repo runtime.

best_opportunities.project: RFQ no. 2026-08-28-006_1 LOT_Procurement of Website Hosting and Technical Support Services for the Encyclopedia of Philippine Art (EPA) Digital Edition
best_opportunities.procuring_entity: Cultural Center of the Philippines - Pasay City Metro Manila
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34) / RFQ
best_opportunities.why_fit: This remains the best overall fit because it is a service-led website hosting and technical-support procurement under a small-value route, with a budget large enough to justify effort and a scope that plausibly aligns with AIStaff’s implementation, support, integrations, and operations capabilities.
important_requirements: Official public abstract directs suppliers to a public RFQ document for the detailed scope and submission package
Public notice says quotation is due on or before September 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM to CCP Procurement Management Division

Post-award documents named in the abstract include signed quotation, valid Business/Mayor's Permit, PhilGEPS Registration, notarized Omnibus Sworn Statement with proof of authority if applicable, and latest 2025 annual income tax return plus business tax returns
Official public contacts shown in the abstract: glycidas.penaranda@culturalcenter.gov.ph, pmd@culturalcenter.gov.ph, and regie.profeta@culturalcenter.gov.ph, tel. 8551-0039
Public abstract still does not clearly state the required PhilGEPS membership level or any prior-project threshold
risks_or_blockers: The public abstract does not summarize the actual hosting architecture, migration scope, uptime/SLA expectations, security responsibilities, or maintenance boundaries
The posting is still classified under Goods / General Support Services, so the buyer may still lean toward an incumbent managed-hosting vendor
Eligibility and technical fit still depend on the detailed RFQ, not the abstract alone
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Review the linked RFQ immediately, confirm whether Red PhilGEPS registration is acceptable, and verify the hosting stack, uptime/support SLA, migration obligations, security responsibilities, and whether website enhancement work is included.

best_opportunities.project: Procurement of One (1) Lot Webhosting and maintenance of Dagupan City Website
best_opportunities.why_fit: This is a fresh and very direct fit for AIStaff’s web operations capability because the public abstract specifically covers webhosting and maintenance of the city website under a low-complexity small-value procurement route.
important_requirements: Official public abstract shows Solicitation Number 286-5N-26
Category is Services, classification is Goods, ABC is PHP 120,000.00, and delivery period is 30 days
Public line item says: webhosting and maintenance of dagupan.gov.ph (renewal, one warranty)
Official public contact shown in the abstract: Monette T. De Venecia, BAC Secretariat Member, asi_aaron@yahoo.com, +63-75-5154780
The public abstract does not expose a detailed eligibility checklist, PhilGEPS membership level, or prior-experience requirement
risks_or_blockers: The phrase renewal suggests incumbent advantage or an existing hosting arrangement that may not be easy to displace
The public abstract is sparse and does not define infrastructure scope, CMS stack, support hours, security obligations, backups, or content-update duties
The budget is modest, so the commercial upside is lower than the CCP opportunity
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Request the RFQ package immediately and clarify whether the requirement is only renewal and maintenance, or includes migration, redevelopment, uptime support, backups, content changes, and security management.

best_opportunities.project: 2026-08-4390 Procurement of Website Development and Implementation Services
best_opportunities.why_fit: This remains a direct website-development procurement with a realistic budget and a 48-day delivery window, so it still fits AIStaff on service compatibility even though the public abstract remains unusually thin.
important_requirements: Official public abstract shows one line item only: Website Development and Implementation Services
Public abstract shows delivery period of 48 days
Official contact shown in the abstract: Gerardo F. L. Micor, BAC Secretariat/PGADH-Provincial Budget Office, quezonbac@gmail.com, (042) 719-1130
Other Information section says to inquire at the Office of the Department of Education (DepEd) - Quezon for details
Public abstract does not clearly state the PhilGEPS membership level requirement, document checklist, or prior-experience threshold
risks_or_blockers: The public abstract is still too sparse to confirm the actual website scope, number of pages, integrations, hosting model, acceptance criteria, or warranty terms
The note to inquire with DepEd-Quezon conflicts with the header that names Province of Quezon as procuring entity
This closes on August 31, 2026 at 8:10 AM PHT, so it may already be impractical unless the RFQ packet is already in hand
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Only pursue if the RFQ packet is already available immediately; otherwise treat this as a monitoring item and focus effort on the CCP and Dagupan notices.

best_opportunities.project: Provision of Communication, advocacy and knowledge management support (Creative services) for UNDRR.
best_opportunities.procuring_entity: UN Secretariat / UNOG on behalf of UNDRR
best_opportunities.why_fit: This is the clearest UNGM fit from today’s live scan because it covers digital media, content production, branding, social media, video, design, campaigns, and knowledge-management support, and the notice allows bidding for only one lot with Basic registration.
important_requirements: Official UNGM notice shows registration level Basic
The EOI covers three lots: Strategic Communications & Media, Digital Content & Multimedia, and Design & Publishing
Bidders may submit for one lot only, two lots, or all three lots
The public notice says services may be delivered directly by the bidder or through approved subcontracting arrangements
Official contact shown publicly: Josette Njomo, josette.njomo@un.org, with a public EOI PDF link
risks_or_blockers: This is an EOI only, not yet a priced solicitation, so effort now mainly buys shortlist access rather than guaranteed proposal rights
UNDRR may still favor agencies with large international creative-services portfolios even though the public registration bar is only Basic
The public notice does not disclose contract value or minimum past-performance thresholds
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Review the public EOI PDF quickly and decide whether AIStaff can credibly position Brandee AI and digital-content services for one lot only, especially Digital Content & Multimedia or Design & Publishing.

urgent_deadlines.note: Carry-forward urgent item. Because the deadline is Monday, August 31, 2026 at 8:10 AM PHT and the public abstract is still sparse, this is only actionable if the RFQ packet is already in hand.

urgent_deadlines.project: Procurement of One (1) Lot Webhosting and maintenance of Dagupan City Website
urgent_deadlines.note: Newly published direct-fit webhosting notice. It closes Wednesday, September 2, 2026 at 12:00 PM PHT and needs immediate RFQ clarification because the abstract is very thin.

not_recommended.project: SUPPLY, DELIVERY, INSTALLATION, COMMISSIONING AND TESTING OF MANAGED VOICE SOLUTION FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A 911 EMERGENCY CONTACT CENTER (EMERGENCY HOTLINE) IN NARRA, PALAWAN
not_recommended.reason: The voice/contact-center theme looks attractive, but the official public abstract requires a similar completed contract worth at least 50% of the ABC, sells paid bidding documents, and reads like a larger end-to-end telecom implementation that is too infrastructure-heavy for AIStaff’s current profile.

not_recommended.procuring_entity: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources - RV
not_recommended.reason: This remains a branded-license and subscription procurement rather than a custom systems, implementation, or managed-service engagement that AIStaff can differentiate on.

not_recommended.project: Strategic Media Placements in Digital Television in Airports and Seaports nationwide maximizing visibility and engagements (NP-1295-2026(B)(14)
not_recommended.reason: This is closer to a media-buy and placement contract than to AIStaff’s higher-margin digital-content, AI, or systems work, and it likely favors vendors with established out-of-home/digital-TV media inventory.

not_recommended.project: Provision of Software and Application Development Services
not_recommended.reason: The scope is genuinely relevant but far too broad and enterprise-heavy for a first UN pursuit: it spans global OICT delivery, cloud, security, AI, data, managed services, and resource augmentation across multiple UN entities.

This requires a prime system integrator to procure, configure, migrate, integrate Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Microsoft 365, train users, and support the platform under SLAs. That is too enterprise-integrator-heavy for AIStaff today.
This is the closest direct chatbot fit in today’s UNGM scan, but it is Spanish-language, Mexico-specific, and likely favors suppliers with local context and Spanish delivery strength.

not_recommended.project: Provision of CRM Solution support and maintenance services for Salesforce application
not_recommended.reason: The CRM theme is relevant, but the public notice explicitly points to recognized Salesforce expertise including Nonprofit Cloud consultant certification, which is a material qualification risk for AIStaff right now.

todays_recommendation.best_opportunity: RFQ no. 2026-08-28-006 Website Hosting and Technical Support Services for the Encyclopedia of Philippine Art (Ref 13217867) remains the best opportunity to pursue today because it is still the strongest service-led fit, carries a better budget than the new Dagupan notice, and closes on Tuesday, September 1, 2026.
documents_to_prepare: Notarized Omnibus Sworn Statement with proof of signatory authority
Latest 2025 annual income tax return and recent business tax returns
One-page capability sheet focused on website operations, implementation, support, AI-assisted customer service, automations, and integrations
Short hosting-and-support approach note covering uptime handling, backups, security, migration, incident response, and support process
If pursuing the UNDRR EOI, a concise Brandee AI / digital-content credentials deck focused on social media, video, branding, campaigns, and content production
clarifications_to_request: For CCP: whether Red PhilGEPS registration is acceptable for this small-value RFQ
For CCP: the exact hosting stack, traffic expectations, uptime/support SLA, backup responsibilities, security scope, and whether website enhancements are included
For Dagupan: whether the requirement is simple renewal of an incumbent provider or a competitive opportunity open to a new hosting/maintenance supplier
For Dagupan: who owns the domain, hosting account, CMS/application stack, backups, and existing support credentials
For Quezon: which entity controls the detailed requirements and submissions, Province of Quezon BAC or DepEd-Quezon
For UNDRR: whether AIStaff should position for one lot only and what minimum international creative-services references are expected in the EOI stage

notes: PhilGEPS was checked only through official public pages. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, or restricted bid-document access was attempted.

Today's PhilGEPS scan reviewed the first visible public page for six scoped categories plus direct rechecks of tracked notices and newly surfaced website/voice/media candidates. This is more complete than the prior conservative targeted-only run, but it is still not a full crawl of every page in each category.
UNGM was checked through the official public search/notices pages using the repo's live public scan script, and at least one current UNGM notice page was manually reviewed before inclusion.
Public attachments were referenced only when they were openly exposed on the notice page, such as the CCP public RFQ link and the UNDRR public EOI PDF link.
Only new opportunities, changed opportunities, or previously reported opportunities closing within three days were kept in BEST OPPORTUNITIES.
No bids were submitted, no registrations were created, and no procurement emails were sent. This run is research and reporting only.
